items.title: Define quantum verifier adapter descriptors
items.context: Add typed adapter definitions for Hamiltonian/spec, basis/grid, solver output, normalization, unitarity/probability conservation, convergence, reference comparison, reproducibility, and figure/table provenance.
items.userSees: Quantum M2 exposes named verifier adapters with explicit evidence kind, required identity fields, and deterministic fail-closed boundaries.

happy.desc: Known M2 adapters are listed with stable ids and evidence kinds.

edge.desc: Adapters can be descriptor-only without executing external commands.

adversarial.desc: No adapter advertises quantum theory, hardware, solver improvement, production, or Authority claims.

items.title: Normalize verifier outputs into quantum receipts
items.context: Add deterministic helper(s) that accept adapter output and active identity, returning QuantumVerifierReceipt-compatible structures or fail-closed reason codes for missing/mismatched output.
items.userSees: Verifier adapter output can be converted into bound receipts that evaluateQuantumClaim can consume.

happy.desc: A valid adapter output normalizes to a passing bound receipt consumed by evaluateQuantumClaim.

edge.desc: Unknown adapter ids or unsupported output versions return deterministic non-admissible results.

items.title: Expose quantum pack verifierAdapters through the pack registry
items.context: Wire a quantum ClaimAdmissibilityPack descriptor with verifierAdapters into the read-only registry without replacing the code-runtime pack or creating new proof storage.
items.userSees: listClaimAdmissibilityPacks includes a quantum pack whose verifierAdapters describe M2 capabilities.

happy.desc: Registry lists both code-runtime and quantum packs.

edge.desc: Quantum pack remains read-only and uses existing proof-admissibility boundaries.

adversarial.desc: Adding the quantum pack does not create duplicate ids, aliases, lifecycle gates, storage roots, or completion claims.

items.title: Extend quantum smoke and update M2 status
items.context: Update the focused smoke and quantum plan status to prove M2 is implemented while M3-M5 remain pending.
items.userSees: npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility prints a passing transcript for M2 verifier adapters.

happy.desc: Focused quantum smoke passes and prints a M2 verifier adapter success line.

edge.desc: Existing M0-M1 stale/missing/mismatch smoke cases still pass.

adversarial.desc: The runtime status says M0-M2 implemented and M3-M5 pending, not full quantum validation.
